lead_raw_text:
The structure of Mg2Mn4Mo2O12 (reduced formula MgMn2MoO6) crystallizes in the trigonal space group R-3m (No. 166), with 20 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies octahedral Mg, Mn, and Mo centers, each coordinated by six O neighbors, while O centers show four geometric neighbors (one Mg, two Mn, one Mo). The periodic neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all 20 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-sharing between Mg and Mn octahedra, corner- and edge-sharing between Mn and Mo octahedra, and edge-sharing among Mn octahedra.
